page_title: HOL 0-2 RBL | Holstein Kiel v RB Leipzig 07/12/2024, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+4' Nothing more will happen in this game as the referee blows for full time.
90+3' Marco Rose has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Faik Sakar (RB Leipzig) replacing Christoph Baumgartner.
90+1' Substitution. Arthur Vermeeren makes his way off the pitch and Kevin Kampl (RB Leipzig) comes on as his replacement.
90' We will have 3 min. of added time.
90' Alexander Bernhardsson (Holstein Kiel) is booked after bringing down an opponent. Florian Badstubner had an easy-decision to make.
89' The corner is swung in but Holstein Kiel can’t take advantage as a defender sweeps the ball away.
89' The corner from Lewis Holtby (Holstein Kiel) is cleared away by the defence. The ball is out of play. Holstein Kiel will have a chance to score from a corner.
85' Benedikt Pichler (Holstein Kiel) is caught offside after the linesman raises his flag.
83' Benjamin Henrichs (RB Leipzig) takes out his opponent with a nasty challenge and is relieved when the referee only gives him a booking.
81' The number of shots on goal at present is 4:5.
80' Substitution. Benedikt Pichler (Holstein Kiel) in, Shuto Machino out.
79' Holstein Kiel seem to be finding their feet as they enjoy some possession. Great movement by the offensive players allows the defenders to set up the attack.
77' Antonio Nusa (RB Leipzig) goes on a solo run, but he fails to create a chance as an opposition player blocks him.
74' Substitution. Marvin Schulz did his best and is replaced by Alexander Bernhardsson (Holstein Kiel).
74' Arthur Vermeeren (RB Leipzig) has tested the patience of referee Florian Badstubner and goes into the book for a previous late challenge.
71' A fantastic block by a defender means that the corner from RB Leipzig comes to nothing.
69' 0 - 2 GOAL! That’s a great strike from the spot by Andre Silva (RB Leipzig) low into the left of the net, giving goalkeeper Timon Weiner no chance!
69' Andre Silva (RB Leipzig) will take the responsibility and he is already preparing the ball.
68' This yellow card was deserved. The tackle by Marvin Schulz (Holstein Kiel) was quite harsh and Florian Badstubner didn't hesitate to show him a yellow card.
68' Marvin Schulz (Holstein Kiel) is penalised for holding. Florian Badstubner signals a set piece. A penalty is awarded to RB Leipzig!
67' Timon Weiner (Holstein Kiel) is awarded a yellow card for a sharp discussion with the referee. He should relax or he could be sent off.

67' Steven Skrzybski (Holstein Kiel) latches onto a good pass inside the box and shoots. The effort beats the keeper, but deflects off the crossbar to safety. The ball goes out of play and RB Leipzig will have a goal kick.
66' The total number of attempts is 7:6.
63' It will be a substitution. Xaver Schlager (RB Leipzig) is ready to enter the pitch as Amadou Haidara walks off.
63' It's time for a substitution. Andre Silva (RB Leipzig) comes on in place of Benjamin Sesko.
63' Marco Rose has decided to make a change. Lukas Klostermann (RB Leipzig) replaces Lutsharel Geertruida.
62' The referee signals a substitution. Lewis Holtby (Holstein Kiel) is brought on as a substitute for Armin Gigovic.

58' A sweeping move ends with a pass to Steven Skrzybski (Holstein Kiel) inside the box. He lets fly towards the bottom right corner, but Peter Gulacsi was watching it all the way and makes a comfortable save.
56' Lois Openda (RB Leipzig) receives a yellow card for talking out of turn to the referee.

53' Marvin Schulz (Holstein Kiel) makes a yard for himself and goes for goal from long range. It never troubles the goalkeeper as it flies into the stands. The ball goes out of play and RB Leipzig will have a goal kick.
51' Wonderful movement by Holstein Kiel. The players are holding possession, mostly exchanging one-touch passes. They control the pace of the game now.
48' Marvin Schulz (Holstein Kiel) decides to take a short corner instead of crossing into the box.
47' Holstein Kiel decide to take a short pass from the free kick and the attacking effort continues.
47' Arthur Vermeeren (RB Leipzig) robs an opponent of the ball and explodes in anger when Florian Badstubner blows for a foul. Holstein Kiel have a free kick.
46' The referee signals that it is time for a substitution and Steven Skrzybski (Holstein Kiel) will replace Magnus Knudsen.
46' The game restarts for the second half.
45+2' Florian Badstubner blows his whistle to signal the end of the first-half action.
45' There will be a minimum of 1 min. of added time.
45' None of the Holstein Kiel players could reach the corner kick as the ball was overhit and goes out of play. The ball goes out of play and RB Leipzig will have a goal kick.
44' The ball is cleared after Lasse Rosenboom (Holstein Kiel) attempted to dribble past an opposing player. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for RB Leipzig.
39' RB Leipzig are showing great team chemistry. They are passing it around beautifully. Excellent team work.
35' Florian Badstubner shows a yellow card to Armin Gigovic (Holstein Kiel) for his blatant foul.
33' 1:5 – this is the total number of shots produced by both teams.
30' Benjamin Henrichs (RB Leipzig) was trying to get to the ball but clattered into the legs of the opponent as well. Florian Badstubner blows his whistle for an infringement.
27' 0 - 1 Goal! Benjamin Sesko (RB Leipzig) gathered the ball off a rebound inside the box and fired home into the bottom left corner.

26' Holstein Kiel slow the tempo of the game down by exchanging a combination of one or two touch passes. The opposition's players are finding it very difficult at the moment, very physically demanding to run without the ball.
24' Nicolas Seiwald (RB Leipzig) whips the ball in from the long-range free kick, but the first man gets it clear.

23' Lois Openda (RB Leipzig) attempts to score as he rises near the penalty spot and heads the ball to the middle of the goal. Timon Weiner pulls off a comfortable save to stop the ball from hitting the net.
22' Lois Openda (RB Leipzig) goes on a mazy run and tries his luck with a mid-range strike, but one of the defending players steps in and makes a block.
20' Benjamin Sesko (RB Leipzig) was standing in a clear offside position, making it an easy call for the linesman.
19' Holstein Kiel have a chance to score from a corner kick, but the ball is cleared by a defender.
18' Holstein Kiel can’t profit from the corner as the defence clear the ball upfield. Holstein Kiel earn a corner.
17' The Holstein Kiel players are displaying brilliant short passes and great ball movement. They are waiting to open the opposition's defence and hit them swiftly on the break.
15' Magnus Knudsen (Holstein Kiel) commits a foul after unfairly battling his opponent for the ball.
14' Armin Gigovic (Holstein Kiel) latches on to a pin-point through ball, but one of the defending players dispossess him. Brilliant defending. It's a throw-in for Holstein Kiel.
13' Florian Badstubner blows his whistle. Nicolai Remberg (Holstein Kiel) commits a foul after dangerous play.
10' Lasse Rosenboom (Holstein Kiel) slides a pass forward, but one of the defenders cuts it out. The ball has crossed the sideline. Holstein Kiel are taking a throw-in.
8' The possession of the ball – 21:79.
5' Antonio Nusa (RB Leipzig) gets on the end of a good pass and from mid-range he unleashes a decent strike, but the shot is blocked by the defender.

3' Long passes, short passes and one-two passes. RB Leipzig are showcasing great team work by keeping possession and producing pin-point passes from player to player. The opposition's players are finding it very difficult to intercept at the moment.
1' The first half has started.
RB Leipzig will kick-off.
Florian Badstubner was nominated as the referee for this game.
